info.title: E-Commerce Platform API
info.description: Comprehensive RESTful API for E-Commerce platform built with Bun, Hono, and Drizzle ORM on AWS EKS & RDS PostgreSQL. Features public storefront endpoints with rich filtering, search, pagination, and stock management.
